fullDescription:
Ever wanted to make beautiful Tiles in Procreate? Look no further! This set includes 20 multistep pattern brushes, which allows you to use different colors and different layers for a beautiful results!

This updated pattern brush pack includes more patterns and new brush functions that make them easier to use!

DETAILS OF WHAT’S INCLUDED:
20 full tile pattern brushes, with over 160 individual brushes total.

WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE:
– A Ornate Tiles 2.0 user guide in .pdf-format
– one .brushset file with all the brushes included, organized into sub-categories for ease of use
– a .pdf with instructions on how to change the pattern brush size

filesize: 86 MB

REQUIREMENTS FOR USE: (not included) These brushes are only compatible with Procreate 5 or higher, and will not work in any other application. For maximal use you will also need a compatible apple pencil.

PLEASE NOTE: It’s not possible to use these brushes to make seamless repeat patterns. The brushes themselves are seamless, but you can’t make a seamless pattern with a Procreate brush.
